feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 May 2026 7:42am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 30 May 2026 at 7:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure continuing to decline near Denmark with shallow low to the west of Ireland.


##Wind##

Southeast 4 or 5, veering south 3 or 4 this morning but occasionally 5 in the west, then increasing south or south-southwest 4 or 5 this evening, but still 3 or less in the east of the area for a time.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Isolated showery outbreaks of rain. Areas or mist and isolated fog patches then spreading from the south during this morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers. Becoming moderate or poor, but very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, but 3 or less in the southeast of the area at first, Becoming south or southeast 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Occasional showers with the risk of mist patches.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor.
